en: A black and white image of a street corner in a European city, featuring a prominent three-story building with signage for a pharmacy/drugstore ('Mohren-Drogerie, Kräuter Gewölbe, Felix Herberg'). The signage on the facade advertises 'Chemikalien, Farben, Parfümerien' (chemicals, paints, perfumes), and 'Drogen, Chemikalien, Farben, Parfümerien.' To the right, another building is labeled 'Kludes Restaurant.' The architecture is typical of late 19th to early 20th-century German towns, with cobbled streets and classic facades.
